description_target.target_text: Top-row markers draw vertical XOR lines: marker color replaces non-marker cells, same-as-marker cells become bg

racket_target.raw_code: (rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((hh (rows g)) (ww (cols g)) (bg (mode g -1)) (result (make-hash))) (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww))) (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c))) (for ((c (range 0 ww))) (when (and (not (= (cell-at g 0 c) bg)) (or (< hh 2) (not (= (cell-at g 0 c) (cell-at g 1 c))))) (let ((marker (cell-at g 0 c))) (for ((r (range 1 hh))) (if (= (hash-ref result (list r c) 0) marker) (hash-set! result (list r c) bg) (hash-set! result (list r c) marker)))))) (grid-from-fn hh ww (lambda (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
racket_target.target_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (bg (mode g -1))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((c (range 0 ww)))
               (when
                 (and (!= (at g 0 c) bg) (or (< hh 2) (!= (at g 0 c) (at g 1 c))))
                 (let ((marker (at g 0 c)))
                   (for ((r (range 1 hh)))
                     (if (= (hash-ref result (list r c) 0) marker)
                         (hash-set! result (list r c) bg)
                         (hash-set! result (list r c) marker))))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
